plain_english_policy: Regulation of demonstrator proximity to abortion clinics (buffer zones).

effects.rationale: Buffer zones limit demonstrators' ability to approach clinic entrances, restricting their freedom of assembly near the site.
Applies to private clinics (not government-run facilities), though it indirectly affects access to abortion services by restricting protest activity around them.

evidence_quote: "buffer zones" by requiring demonstrators to stay at least 15 feet away from abortion clinic doorways and driveways.
